messages:
deploy-bot: Canary alert — prompt-router-v2 (new endpoint) 5xx rate jumped to ~48% over last 15m. Canary score: FAIL.
alex: seeing it in Grafana too, real user errors. Some customers getting 502s. Paging oncall.
oncall-pager: Paging alex (oncall) — acknowledged. Sending PD.
alex: on it, joining bridge in 60s. Any recent deploys?
kevin: deploy completed ~10m ago (canary rollout 30%). Release tag: release/prompt-router-v2.
maya: this was the experimental route for the EnvA customers, we started traffic at 10:12.
emily: Support: 3 customers already opened tickets reporting truncated responses. One reported timeouts in production.
alex: quick check: traffic to prompt-router-v2 shows request latency spike and immediate 5xx surge after new kernel selection. CPU on pods normal, but error stack shows model-serve connection refused.
kevin: grabbing logs from canary pods: "ConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer" repeated. Possible upstream model process crash after quantization kernel change.
alex: recommendation: kill the feature flag routing new endpoint so traffic falls back to stable prompt-router. Can someone flip ff:promptrouter.v2 to OFF?
maya: I can flip via FF dashboard if we confirm rollback. Flipping will route traffic to stable endpoint (prompt-router-v1).
kevin: before flip, snapshot config: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://flags.internal/api/v1/flags/promptrouter.v2 > /tmp/flag.json`
emily: customers losing requests, please flip now. CS asks for immediate mitigation.
alex: do the flip. Post the audit link.
maya: flipped ff:promptrouter.v2 -> false :white_check_mark:  (audit id: audit_2026_03_17_001)
incident-bot: Feature flag promptrouter.v2 set to OFF by maya. Traffic re-routed to prompt-router-v1. Canary traffic cleared.
kevin: confirming: canary pods for v2 now at 0% traffic. Stable route showing 200s. Error rate dropping.
emily: notifying impacted customers that we're rolling traffic back and investigating.
alex: creating incident doc and tagging SRE for root cause. Assigning to kevin for postmortem. Handing off to next oncall in 25m — @oncall-pager will take over monitoring.
oncall-pager: acknowledged, I'll watch for regressions and escalate if error rate >1% for 10m.
kevin: collecting core dumps and model logs, will attempt to reproduce with kernel flags used in canary. Suspect kernel/quantization combo.
maya: PR to revert kernel selection already opened: https://git.internal/repo/1234 — will hold for safety.
alex: thanks everyone. Transitioning to follow-up workflow. I'll post a short customer-facing note once we validate stability for 30m.
emily: CS will hold a template message ready.
incident-bot: Incident severity set to SEV2, incident_id INC-2026-0317-09, creators: alex.
kevin: tagging infra to check GPU driver mismatch during canary — cc @infra.
maya: handoff complete to @oncall-pager, leaving bridge.
oncall-pager: taking over. Monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.internal/d/xyz/prompt-router.
alex: closing active paging loop; will remain on incident doc for follow-up. Good job. :thumbsup:
